chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"Successful indeed is the one who purifies himself."
He عليه السلام said: "The one who gives the fitrah."
Then it was said to him: "And remembers the name of his Lord, then prays."
He عليه السلام said: "He went out to the prayer ground and performed the prayer."

key_terms.اسْمَ رَبِّهِ: the name of his Lord, meaning remembrance of Allah
key_terms.الْجَبَّانَةِ: the open prayer ground outside the town
key_terms.الْفِطْرَةَ: the fitrah charity given at the end of Ramadan
key_terms.تَزَكَّىٰ: purified himself; interpreted here as giving the fitrah
key_terms.فَصَلَّىٰ: then prayed; interpreted here as performing the Eid prayer

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام interpret the verses "قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ تَزَكَّىٰ" and "وَذَكَرَ اسْمَ رَبِّهِ فَصَلَّىٰ"?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explains the verse "قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ تَزَكَّىٰ" as referring to one who gives the fitrah. He further explains "وَذَكَرَ اسْمَ رَبِّهِ فَصَلَّىٰ" as going out to the prayer ground and performing the Eid prayer, linking the verses to the rites of Eid al-Fitr.
